stories.title: Vakgenoten over Paulien Cornelisse: ‘Haar manier van kijken is niet in één woord te vangen, ‘Paulinisme’ komt het dichtst in de buurt’

en.title: Colleagues on Paulien Cornelisse: 'Her way of looking at things cannot be captured in one word, "Paulinism" comes closest'
en.summary: Writer and cabaret performer Paulien Cornelisse died on Wednesday. Colleagues describe her distinctive perspective and approach to language and performance as difficult to summarize in a single term.

stories.title: Vakgenoten over het verlies van hun vriendin Paulien Cornelisse. ‘Ze was scherp, maar zonder iemand pijn te doen’

en.title: Colleagues on the loss of their friend Paulien Cornelisse. 'She was sharp, but without hurting anyone'
en.summary: Colleagues remembered writer and cabaret performer Paulien Cornelisse following her death, praising her wit and compassionate approach to her work and relationships.

stories.title: Vier doden door westnijlvirus, volgens RIVM is Nederland over de piek van huidige uitbraak heen

en.title: Four deaths from West Nile virus; according to RIVM, the Netherlands has passed the peak of current outbreak
en.summary: The Netherlands has recorded four deaths from West Nile virus, and new infection rates have declined in recent weeks, suggesting the country has passed the peak of the current outbreak.

stories.title: Slimste Mens hervat uitzendingen met eerbetoon aan Paulien Cornelisse

en.title: De Slimste Mens resumes broadcasts with tribute to Paulien Cornelisse
en.summary: Game show De Slimste Mens resumed its season with a tribute to late jury member Paulien Cornelisse, who died at age 50 from cancer. The show had been pre-recorded earlier and will air with a memorial acknowledgment.

stories.title: Studenten sluiten zich aan bij Franse scholierenprotesten, meer acties aangekondigd

en.title: Students join French school protests, more actions announced
en.summary: University students in France have joined secondary school protests blocking schools and campuses to demand increased education funding. Nearly thirty universities are blocked across major cities including Paris, Lyon, and Lille.

stories.title: Echtgenoot van Paulien Cornelisse schrijft over haar columns: 'Groot geschenk'

en.title: Husband of Paulien Cornelisse writes about her columns: 'Great gift'
en.summary: Chris Bajema, husband of deceased writer and performer Paulien Cornelisse, published a column reflecting on his appreciation for how his wife wrote her newspaper columns.

stories.title: Vier nieuwe doden met westnijlvirus, maar uitbraak lijkt af te vlakken

en.title: Four new deaths from West Nile virus, but outbreak appears to be declining
en.summary: Four deaths from West Nile virus occurred this week in the Netherlands, marking the largest weekly increase since August, though authorities believe the outbreak has peaked. Nine total deaths have been recorded this year.

stories.title: Paulien Cornelisse was geen schoolmeester, haar plezier in taal was de sleutel tot haar succes

en.title: Paulien Cornelisse was no schoolteacher, her pleasure in language was the key to her success
en.summary: Paulien Cornelisse achieved success through her genuine enjoyment of language rather than through didactic or instructional approach.

stories.title: Nog vier patiënten met westnijlvirus overleden: 'Piek van uitbraak lijkt geweest'

en.title: Four more patients with West Nile virus died: 'Peak of outbreak appears to have passed'
en.summary: Twelve new West Nile virus infections were reported this week, with four patients dying. Health authorities expect the outbreak's peak to have already occurred.

stories.title: Als cabaretier trok Paulien Cornelisse het publiek moeiteloos haar unieke gedachtewereld in

en.title: As a cabaret performer, Paulien Cornelisse effortlessly drew audiences into her unique world of thought
en.summary: Paulien Cornelisse was a cabaret performer known for captivating audiences with her distinctive creative perspective.

en.title: Radio and theater maker Chris Bajema, the partner of Paulien Cornelisse, wrote a 150 for her
en.summary: Chris Bajema, a radio and theater creator and partner of Paulien Cornelisse, composed a work of 150 units for her.

stories.title: Paulien Cornelisse (50) overleden: veelzijdig verzamelaar van observaties over gedrag en taal

en.title: Paulien Cornelisse (50) deceased: versatile collector of observations about behavior and language
en.summary: Dutch performer and artist Paulien Cornelisse has died at age 50. She was known for her diverse work collecting and analyzing observations about human behavior and language.
